name: Lokey: Private AI Keyboard
subtitle: Clearer words. On your iPhone.
promotional_text: A private keyboard for English and French. Fix grammar and spelling on your iPhone, with AZERTY, offline AI, and one-tap Undo.
description:
Lokey is an everyday iPhone keyboard with private AI help for English and French. Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation in the apps where you already type.

YOUR WORDS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
Corrections run on your device after a one-time model download. The keyboard sends no text to a server. No account, ads, analytics, or subscription.

FIX, REVIEW, APPLY
Tap Fix to see a clear correction. Review the changes, then apply them. Automatic mode fixes small errors when you finish a sentence, with one-tap Undo. Choose Suggest if you prefer to approve each edit.

A FAMILIAR KEYBOARD
Choose QWERTY, AZERTY, or QWERTZ. Hold letter keys for accents. Use extra tools to rewrite tone or translate text.

A SIMPLE SETUP
A guided install helps you add Lokey in iPhone Settings and switch to it with the globe key. Full Access is optional. It lets the keyboard report setup status to the app; it is not used to upload your text.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Download the AI model over Wi-Fi and keep Lokey open until it finishes. After that, corrections work offline. AI can miss errors or make an incorrect suggestion. Review edits before you send. iOS uses its own keyboard for passwords and some other fields. Some apps block custom keyboards.

Free and open source. Code under MIT; AI models by Liquid AI under the LFM Open License v1.0.
